title: The Music Book

description.main: A collection of musician portraits by Mark Seliger, mostly from Rolling Stone and Vanity Fair, published by teNeues in 2008.
description.extended:
A collection of music portraits by the American photographer Mark Seliger, drawn from his magazine work.

teNeues published the book in 2008 as a hardcover about 34 cm tall. It gathers portraits of musicians from the 1980s onward, most first printed in Rolling Stone and Vanity Fair. Subjects include Bono, Johnny Cash, Bruce Springsteen, Snoop Dogg and Dolly Parton. Tom Wolfe is credited as a contributor. The cover lists the title as Mark Seliger: The Music Book.

Seliger was Chief Photographer at Rolling Stone from 1992 to 2002, then worked under contract to Condé Nast for GQ and Vanity Fair until 2012. His other books include Physiognomy and On Christopher Street: Transgender Stories.
